batch_meta.notes: Batch 2 of 10 peptides: humanin, mots-c, snap-8, pinealon, aod-9604, ghrp-2, ghrp-6, hexarelin, ll-37, thymulin. Pricing primarily from Core Peptides + Umbrella Labs (verified by direct WebFetch). Peptide Sciences blocked WebFetch (403). Finnrick has only paid-request landings, no completed COAs. Note: user-provided PMID 11371619 for humanin Hashimoto 2001 is incorrect; the actual paper is Hashimoto et al. 2001 PNAS 98:6336-6341 (DOI 10.1073/pnas.101133498); attempts to fetch PNAS were blocked (403) so cited via PubMed. Core Peptides sells Thymalin (different peptide), not Thymulin; thymulin not found at preferred vendors.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Studied preclinically for neuroprotection in Alzheimer's disease and metabolic disease; no human clinical trials registered as of 2026.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not marketed as a drug; sold as research peptide only.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Presumed proteolytic degradation (peptidases); IGFBP-3 binding modulates clearance kinetics in rodents.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: HNG analog half-life ~30 min in wildtype mice; >4 h in rats; PK is species-dependent and modulated by IGFBP-3 binding. No published human PK data.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Preclinical research in metabolic homeostasis, insulin sensitivity, obesity, exercise physiology.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved; sold as research peptide.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Lee 2015 used 0.5 and 5 mg/kg/day IP in mice. No published human PK studies as of 2026-04.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Topical cosmetic ingredient; INCI name 'Acetyl Octapeptide-3'; used in anti-wrinkle formulations at 3-10% in cosmetic products.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Marketed globally as cosmetic ingredient (not a drug). Used topically only.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Topical use; minimal systemic absorption expected. Skin peptidase degradation likely.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Topical cosmetic; no systemic PK data published. Mechanism: SNARE complex inhibition mimicking SNAP-25.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Khavinson short-peptide bioregulator; studied for neuroprotection, cognitive support, AD models. No Western regulatory approval.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved as a drug; sold as research peptide. May be available in Russia as part of Khavinson 'bioregulator' product line.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: No published PK studies. Most primary literature from Khavinson group (Saint Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology); no independent Western validation as of 2026.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Obesity / weight loss; failed phase 2b primary endpoint (no statistically significant weight loss vs placebo over 24 weeks in 536 subjects); development terminated in 2007. Now sold as research peptide; some jurisdictions may treat as cosmetic.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved; development discontinued 2007. Sold as research peptide; no FDA approval.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Subcutaneous injection in trials; oral bioavailability low (sub-2000 Da peptide).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: NCT00318383 Phase 2b OPTIONS Study (2005-2007) enrolled 536 subjects BMI 30-45, 24-week double-blind, no statistically significant weight loss vs placebo.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Diagnostic agent for adult and pediatric growth hormone deficiency assessment.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Marketed in Japan only as diagnostic GH stimulation test (single 100 mcg IV bolus). Not approved by FDA or EMA. WADA prohibited substance for athletes.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Hexapeptide D-Ala-D-2-Nal-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2; MW 817.97 Da. Approved as 100 mcg IV diagnostic bolus; peak GH within 15-30 min, baseline by 60-90 min.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Investigational GH secretagogue; recent phase I/II study in acute ischemic stroke (Cuban) combined with EGF. WADA prohibited.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved anywhere as drug. Sold as research peptide. Investigated in Cuban-led EGF+GHRP-6 stroke trial (2017-2018).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Cabrales 2013: IV bolus 100/200/400 mcg/kg in 9 healthy male volunteers; distribution t1/2 7.6 +/- 1.9 min, elimination t1/2 2.5 +/- 1.1 h, bi-exponential PK profile, AUC roughly proportional to dose.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Investigational synthetic GH secretagogue; multiple older clinical PK and dose-response studies in 1990s; not pursued to approval.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved. Sold as research peptide. WADA prohibited.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Peptidase degradation; terminal half-life ~120 min in rats.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Roumi 1995 Peptides: rat PK after IV bolus showed terminal t1/2 120 min, plasma clearance 4.28 mL/min/kg, Vss 387.7 mL/kg. SC dosing 1-100 mcg/kg gave clearance 3.93-5.17 mL/min/kg, Vd 316-544 mL/kg.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Endogenous human cathelicidin antimicrobial peptide (37 aa, sequence LLGDFFRKSKEKIGKEFKRIVQRIKDFLRNLVPRTES). Studied as topical wound-healing agent; phase II topical trials reported for analogs (e.g., Lytixar/LTX-109).
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved as a drug. Sold as research peptide. INN 'ropocamptide' assigned. PubChem CID 16198951.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Peptidase degradation; topical and parenteral routes investigated.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: MW 4493.34 Da; C205H340N60O53. No published systemic human PK data.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Endogenous zinc-binding nonapeptide thymic hormone (Pyr-Ala-Lys-Ser-Gln-Gly-Gly-Ser-Asn). Discovered Bach 1977 as 'facteur thymique sérique' (FTS). Studied for T-cell differentiation, immunomodulation; no drug approval.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved. Distinct from Thymalin (a polypeptide thymic extract sold as research compound).
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Peptidase degradation; very short half-life (~10 min) reported for free thymulin.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Zinc binding required for activity (1:1 ratio induces specific 3D conformation). Free thymulin half-life ~10 min; PBCA nanoparticle formulations have been investigated to extend half-life.

dosing_rows.population: C57BL/6J mice; HFD-fed obesity and aging models
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Daily IP for up to 8 weeks; primary studies used 5 mg/kg/day, extended studies used 0.5 mg/kg/day
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Prevented age- and HFD-induced insulin resistance and diet-induced obesity; activated AMPK pathway.

dosing_rows.population: Adults and children with suspected GH deficiency
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Single IV bolus; peak GH measured 15-30 min post-dose; cutoff >9 ng/mL adults, >16 ng/mL children for sufficiency.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Stimulates GH release for diagnostic differentiation of GH-deficient vs GH-sufficient individuals.

dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Single IV bolus at 100, 200, or 400 mcg/kg of body weight
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Bi-exponential PK with distribution t1/2 7.6 min and elimination t1/2 2.5 h; AUC dose-proportional.

dosing_rows.population: 536 adults BMI 30-45 kg/m^2, age 18-65, waist >102 cm M / >95 cm F
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: 24-week randomized double-blind drug or placebo; primary endpoint weight loss at 12 weeks.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: No statistically significant weight loss vs placebo; development terminated 2007.

dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Recommended use rate 3-10% in serum/cream/gel formulations applied to forehead/eye areas.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Reduces appearance of dynamic wrinkles by inhibiting SNARE complex; ~30% more active than parent peptide Argireline in vitro/in vivo.

dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Investigated as topical agent for polymicrobial wound infections; promotes angiogenesis and epithelial cell migration.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Antimicrobial activity vs Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens, anti-biofilm, wound-healing properties.
